tool_input.command: (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1; pnpm typecheck 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "--- tests"; timeout 120 pnpm test 2>&1 | tail -60)
tool_input.description: Install deps, typecheck, and run the test suite

result:
`GET /orders` now returns each order's `items`, and the typecheck and all 7 tests pass against the local database.

Each item has `product_id`, `name`, `quantity` and `price_cents`. I used `price_cents` to match the existing `order_items` column and `/products`. Items are sorted by `product_id`, and an order with no items returns `[]`.

The change is in `src/app.ts`. The orders and their items come back in one query using a correlated subquery, so there's no per-order lookup. I also added a test in `test/app.test.ts` that checks Alice's two orders include the expected items. I haven't committed anything.
